TechnologyStack.Runtime: node 20.x+ (ESM / NodeNext; dev & tests run TypeScript directly via tsx; @types/node ^22.10)
TechnologyStack.Framework: none — standalone library; storage engine is PostgreSQL 17 + TimescaleDB, session store is Redis

dep.name: postgres
dep.purpose: PostgreSQL client (porsager/postgres) — tagged-template SQL, connection pool, LISTEN/NOTIFY for watch()

dep.name: fastest-validator
dep.purpose: Compiles per-class validators from Schema.attributes DSL; used by M-SCHEMA (loaded via createRequire) and by schema-sync

dep.name: tsx
dep.purpose: Run TypeScript/ESM without a build step; hosts the node:test runner and the bench scripts

dep.name: @types/node
dep.purpose: Node builtin typings (crypto, child_process, net, fs/promises, timers/promises, module, url, path, util)

dep.name: ioredis
dep.purpose: Redis client that satisfies the injected SessionStore shape (used by tests/demos, not by the core)

constraint.reason: Relies on porsager/postgres tagged-template API and unsafe()/reserve() semantics
NodeNext module resolution with explicit .js import specifiers and unique symbol exports
Docker image timescale/timescaledb:latest-pg17; gen_random_uuid(), clock_timestamp(), jsonb_path_ops GIN
create_hypertable() on Entity(updated); optional compression/retention policies

PreferredAgentStack.preferred-observability-library: none — console.log/console.warn plus the onQuery(QueryEvent) hook and pg_notify → watch()

module-level.focus: Single integration test against the dev container (real Postgres + Redis)

Testing.mocking-policy: Integration-first: tests run against a real Postgres+Redis dev container provisioned by letopis.up(); no in-process DB mocks. Test contents are out of the documented scope (not analyzed).

Observability.log-format: [letopis.up] <message> for bootstrap; "letopis: slow query <ms>ms — <mode> <classes>" for slow queries
Observability.required-fields: QueryEvent { mode, classes, ms, rows, slow } delivered to the onQuery hook
Observability.redaction: Never log secrets: password hashes, API-key/secret plaintext, TOTP secrets, OTP codes and session tokens are hashed (sha256) or never printed. anonymize() erases string fields in place.

ChangeEvents.mechanism: Postgres trigger entity_notify AFTER INSERT → pg_notify('<schema>', payload); M-CHAIN.watch() LISTENs and reconnects
ChangeEvents.payload: WatchEvent { partition, class, id, updated, deleted }

DeliveryShape.shape: npm package "letopis" v0.18.0 (MIT, ESM). Published files: dist/ (tsc output), sql/, docker/, README.md, CHANGELOG.md. Public entry: dist/index.js (types dist/index.d.ts). Dev/CI via tsx; no bundler.
